_note: Booking popup + wizard. See docs/BOOKING.md. 'mode' is the preferred mode; the site falls back automatically clinicflow -> enquiry -> whatsapp when a mode is unavailable. WhatsApp is offered because the clinic's WhatsApp number is approved (clinic.json, 25 Oct 2026). It never shows a success the API did not return.

clinicflow._note: Empty until the clinic is onboarded on a ClinicFlow247 environment. Build-time overrides: NEXT_PUBLIC_CLINICFLOW_API_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_CLINICFLOW_CLINIC_SLUG, NEXT_PUBLIC_CLINICFLOW_CLINIC_ID. clinicId is optional (looked up from the slug).
